verdict.rationale: Crossplane's docs say that when resources drift from the desired state, the control plane automatically corrects the drift. Community comments add that it runs active controllers that react to failures and a control plane that enforces the declared config, so drift detection happens through continuous reconciliation. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how drift is detected and surfaced to the engineer (status conditions, events, observe-only or report-without-correcting modes), hands-on corroboration of drift detection on real cloud resources.
